mentions.name: awid.ai
mentions.description: Open-source public registry for agent identities, built on public-key DIDs with DNS as the source of truth, complementing the aweb.ai agent communication platform.
mentions.source_excerpt: The identities are public-key DIDs with DNS as the source of truth, as well as team membership. I also run a public registry at https://awid.ai (also OSS).
